Overview

"I was bitten by a snake."
This article is about a subject that is relevant to both the main Ninjago storyline and The LEGO Ninjago Movie. Information may be more directed toward one continuity than the other.

The following is a list of general foods that have appeared in the Ninjago franchise. Some foods are variations unique to the Ninjago world, while others are additionally documented as weapons in sets.

Alcohol[]

Alcohol is a beverage in Ninjago that has an impairing effect on its users.

History

History[]

Pirates vs. Ninja (flashback)[]

A drunken pirate on Destiny's Bounty sat in a barrel and knocked over a bottle of alcohol before telling Captain Soto that No-Eyed Pete was steering the ship.

Prior to Possession[]

One night, Ronin became drunk at a bar and was later approached by Soul Archer (using the pseudonym "Sultan Archron"), who offered him another drink. Taking advantage of his inebriated state, Soul Archer tricked Ronin into making a trade that involved his soul.[1]

On a Wish and a Prayer[]

The following events were undone due to Jay's final wish, and thus, did not happen in the current timeline.

The ninja encountered a drunken Ship Captain who held an empty alcohol flask.

The following events occurred after Jay made his final wish, and thus, happened.

Way of the Departed[]

During his time in Nom, Ronin noted that his investors are slightly intoxicated, which was useful for him. He later noted that the investors were "too tired and too tipsy" to be thinking about money at the moment.

Appearances

Appearances[]

Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu[]

Season 2: Legacy of the Green Ninja[]

  • 15. "Pirates vs. Ninja" (flashback)

Season 6: Skybound[]

  • 59. "On a Wish and a Prayer"

Books[]

  • Way of the Departed (mentioned)
Trivia

Trivia[]

  • Bars such as Yang Tavern, Biker Tavern, and Laughy's presumably sell alcohol, but this is never shown or stated in the TV series, because Ninjago is made for children. As such, other drinks such as juice (in "The Invitation") and boba tea (in "The Oni and the Dragon" and "Ninjago Confidential") are shown or mentioned instead.
  • The alcohol drank by the Ship Captain appears to be the same brand of alcohol drank by the drunken pirate on the Destiny's Bounty, as both flasks have an apple on the logo and are the same shape.
  • Based on the apple logo, it can be assumed that alcoholic beverages in Ninjago are a type of cider.

Algae[]

“They've stolen our village and they're eating all our algae.”
— An algae farmer to Lloyd and Arin, "Gangs of the Sea"

"Flying Lessons"
Algae is an edible plant that grows in the Endless Sea.

History

History[]

Background[]

Algae is a type of edible plant that grows naturally in bodies of water and serves as a source of nutrition for various aquatic life, including the Crab monster. After The Merge, a village that specializes in the cultivation of algae fell under the control of the Ocean gang and the Crab monster. The gang managed to drive out the village's inhabitants by breaking off a portion of their floating village and forcing them out to sea. With the village now under the control of the Ocean gang, the Crab monster was able to freely feast on the algae that had been cultivated by the farmers.

Gangs of the Sea[]

One evening, after driving out a pair of interlopers, members of the Ocean gang were seen passing around plates of algae.

Following the defeat of the Crab monster, the algae farmers resumed their cultivation operations, with one farmer being seen working alongside a member of the Ocean gang to harvest algae.

History

History[]

The Maze of the Sphinx (flashback)[]

Wu and Garmadon eat two pieces of cake.

Legacy of the Green Ninja[]

Double Trouble[]

Cole mentions cake multiple times as the ninja visit Darkley's Boarding School for Bad Boys. Later, as the ninja return home, Cole rides the Ultra Dragon while eating cake.

Rebooted[]

When Cyrus Borg says he has a gift for the ninja, Cole asks if it's cake and is disappointed when it's not.

Tournament of Elements[]

Only One Can Remain[]

As Cole is introduced to his new room on Chen's Island, he notices the arrangement of food from Chen's Noodle House. To his delight, cake was included in the display.

Skybound[]

Enkrypted[]

When the ninja were being kept inside Kryptarium Prison, Dareth sent them a cake with tools baked inside to help them escape. Cole then revealed that he ate the cake, claiming it was crunchy.

Prior to Season 8[]

Cole decided to stop eating cake for unknown reasons.

Sons of Garmadon[]

The Mask of Deception[]

When the ninja accept to guard the Oni Mask of Deception, Hutchins shows them around the palace. As they enter the buffet room, he points out all the food they have, including cake. Jay then eats some, trying to persuade Cole to do the same.

Hunted[]

Firstbourne[]

Chopper Maroon and Mohawk approach a figure in green, who turned out to be Dareth. They look through his belongings, which includes cake. They then thank him for the breakfast and walk off.

How to Build a Dragon[]

As the Resistance celebrate Lloyd's speech, Dareth passes around a tray filled with cake.

The Weakest Link[]

Cole asks himself why he gave up cake when Jay reminds him that his "body is a temple". Faith questions Cole about cake, and he replies by describing it.

Lessons for a Master[]

After being freed by the Dragon Hunters, Kai is still hesitant, claiming to eat Cole first because he was full of cake.

Green Destiny[]

The citizens of Ninjago celebrate the defeat of Garmadon by surprising the ninja with a party, complete with cake.

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu[]

Elemental Rider[]

The Venomari are seen stealing cake from Ninjago citizens. It is later returned to them by Kai and Zane.

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu[]

Wasted True Potential[]

Cole finds chocolate ganache cake in the fridge at the monastery. He attempted to eat it, but he fell through a trapdoor that was set up by Wu.

Questing for Quests[]

Cole asks Noble whether they had any cake at the prison cafeteria.

Seabound[]

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Cole tries to answer the Sphinx's riddle with cake, stating that cake is the answer to everything.

Crystalized[]

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

The ninja are given cake as part of their lunch, but it was completely dry to the point it was hard as a rock. Pythor then started a brief food fight by throwing a slice of cake at Kai.

Dragons Rising, Season 3[]

Human Resources[]

As boxes and barrels slid around the Temple Bounty, Lloyd noticed a birthday cake resting on a box and asked Jay about it. Jay responded cryptically, saying they should hope it remains unused. Later, when Wyldfyre, Jay, Lloyd, and Nya's path was blocked by a group of Administration Agents, Jay ordered Lloyd to give him the cake. Lloyd pulled the cake out of his backpack and handed it to Jay. Jay used the cake to stage a fake birthday, allowing them to get away from Allen and Underwood. A few moments later, Underwood and Allen ate slices of the cake while chasing and blasting at the four of them. Once the three ninja and Jay escaped, Allen happily ate the remainder of his slice.

Happy Birthday to You! (non-canon)[]

Cole carries a cake as various villains attack the ninja from portals.

The LEGO Ninjago Movie[]

As Garmadon and his Shark Army return to their volcano base, a soldier tells the bakery team to put the victory cake back into the fridge.

After Lloyd comes home from school, he insists he is tired to Koko and goes to bed. Koko holds up a cake as a birthday surprise, but sighs when she realizes he is gone.

Trivia

Trivia[]

  • Cake being Cole's favorite food was a running gag in "Double Trouble." It has since become a core part of his character.
    • Prior to the events of the eighth season, Cole gave it up, saying that his "body is a temple," and wanting to become more responsible in Master Wu's absence.
      • This is expanded on in Way of the Departed, where Cole explains, "Eating cake is like muscle memory to me. It's just something I do to occupy my hands and mouth sometimes. I love cake but I think it would be healthy for me to cut back. In several ways."
    • After his extended time away from real food while stranded in the Realm of Oni and Dragons, Cole rescinded his denouncement of cake and gained a newfound appreciation of it.
  • According to Tommy Andreasen, if Cole was a YouTuber, his videos would be about "the joys of cake".[3]
  • Tommy Andreasen jokingly stated that Cole's love interest is cake.[4]
  • Tommy Andreasen said that because Cole is the Master of Earth, his favorite type of cake would likely be Sand Cake.[5] He later implied that Cole's favorite flavor of cake is Chocolate Ganache.[6]

Rise of the Snakes[]

Never Trust a Snake[]

The Snake King[]

When the Ninja arrive at the Mega Monster Amusement Park only to find out that Samurai X was one step ahead of them, Sensei Wu somehow already made his way to the park with a cotton candy in his hand.

Unsinkable[]

Human Resources[]

Between You and Lee[]

In the morning hours along the coast of the Land of Lee, Lee greeted a passing ship and traded over several crates of candy mushrooms in exchange for supplies.

Coconuts are a type of fruit consumed in Ninjago and Mysterium. One was created by the sorceress Gandalaria as a backup copy of herself.

History

History[]

The Last Hope[]

As the ninja trained on the beach on the Dark Island with their new Elemental Blades, Kai threw a coconut into the distance and then burned it with his blade.

My Dinner With Nadakhan[]

To get rid of the sand eels on Tiger Widow Island's beach, Lloyd, Cole and Nya built a catapult that threw coconuts and they scattered the eels while the ninja tried to transfer the raft to the water. However, the invention was broken and the sand eels attacked the ninja.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

When the ninja and Twitchy Tim were in the uncharted jungle on the uncharted island, they heard loud growling and then a coconut fell from a tree to the ground, behind which one of the Jungle Dragons jumped down. When the hungry Cole noticed the coconut, he tried to get it, but the dragon threw it away, only to be able to bring it back. When Nya realized he just wanted to play, she threw a coconut and Zippy, as they called the dragon, ran after it and quickly brought it back. However, realizing that they had a more important task, Nya threw a coconut deep into the jungle and Zippy ran after him while the ninja left. Later, when they were deeper in the jungle, the coconut fell from the tree to Kai's katana. Cole was glad he could finally have a drink, but when Zippy reappeared and licked the coconut, Cole told him he could keep.

The Gift of Jay[]

When Lloyd was about to save the ninja from the Keepers' Village, Zippy appeared next to him and wanted to play with a coconut. Lloyd was about to throw a coconut into the jungle, but then he noticed the Keepers coming and threw the coconut at them. As the Keepers wondered what had happened, Zippy jumped on them to get his coconut, sparking chaos in the village.

Secrets of the Wyldness[]

While combatting Administration Agents at the Monastery of Mysterium, Gandalaria used her crystal ball to generate and fire coconuts at the agents. The spell for generating coconuts however, seemed to have been unintended, as Gandalaria remarked, "Coconuts? That's a first."

History

Wu's Teas (non-canon)[]

Undercover Zane[]

While Zane was on a mission to infiltrate and sabotage the Coffee Shop, he iced the espresso machine with the intention of upsetting customers. However, this attempt backfired when a female customer discovered her ordered hot coffee was cold, she was initially getting annoyed but fell in love with it after tasting it. The customer called to all the surrounding townspeople to try to iced coffee, much to Zane's dismay.

Cookies are a type of food in Ninjago.

History

History[]

Wu's Teas[]

Undercover Zane (non-canon)[]

A plate of cookies can be seen on the counter of the Robot Manager's Coffee Shop.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Before Jay was about to eat a cookie, Kai stole it from him and ate it. There was one cookie left on the plate, so Jay and Kai challenged each other to see who could break the most bricks. Kai won and Jay was about to give him the cookie, but Wu stormed into the courtyard.

While the ninja were meditating, Jay was about to eat the last cookie, but Wu knocked it out of his hand and it flew into Zane's hand. He then gave it to Kai and he was about to eat it, but Kai got scared by Wu and it flew out of his hands. The cookie was flying in Cole's direction, but the chicken caught it instead.

Courage[]

As Wu congratulates the ninja for passing each Virtue, the chicken, while on top of Cole's head, gives the latter the cookie.

Fortune cookies are a type of common cookie product in Ninjago City. They are commonly found in and around Chen's Noodle House and produced in the noodle factory on Chen's Island.

History

History[]

The Invitation[]

Kai, Cole, Jay, and Lloyd found a plate of cookies behind the noodle house after a conflict with the Anacondrai Cultists. They all looked at the fortunes (Cole eating his cookie whole, fortune and all), which would lead them to enter the Tournament of Elements, and the fortunes vanished (with Cole's fortune vanishing inside him). They left the cookies there as they returned back home.

Spy for a Spy[]

While making fortune cookies in the noodle factory, Cole writes a note to inform the other ninja that he has found Zane and is in the process of planning an escape. He hides the note in one of the cookies that are to be distributed to the remaining Elemental Masters. Skylor ends up getting the cookie, and she informs Kai of Cole's whereabouts.

Trivia

Trivia[]

  • According to Tommy Andreasen, Cole's fortune cookie said "BURP!"[8]
  • In "The Quiet One", Jay said that Wu is "like a living fortune cookie," due to his mysterious and cryptic nature.

Noodles are a type of food in Ninjago. They have a milky gold color with a brief appearance of the noodle's soup. It is often eaten with chopsticks but never eaten with forks. They are offered as a main menu in Chen's Noodle House and the Ramen noodle cart.

History

History[]

Tournament of Elements[]

The Invitation[]

When Lloyd decided to bring the team back together, they met up at Chen's Noodle House, in which different varieties of noodles were served on a conveyor belt.

Ninja Roll[]

When Cole was brought to the Noodle factory, he forcefully joined Karlof, Jacob Pevsner and the other works in chopping noodles.

Spy for a Spy[]

When Cole fought the Anacondrai Cultists in the factory, he begins eating strings of noodles, and even uses them to escape, but ends up landing in Zugu's clutches.

In Shadow of Ronin (non-canon)[]

Whilst in Chen's palace, one of Ronin's goons ask for some noodles. If the player serves him the wrong noodles, he chucks it away. The player must find the correct noodles to give him.

Possession[]

Ghost Story[]

When the four original ninja wake up in the Forest of Tranquility, they are eating noodles for breakfast, but Kai's bowl of noodles was being eaten by a walloper.

Curseworld, Part I[]

When the Ghost Warriors invaded Stiix, many of them were eating different types of food, including noodles.

Skybound[]

Operation Land Ho![]

Noodles were present in the display at Chen's Noodle House when Jay arrived to recruit Skylor for his Ninja Replacements.

Tall Tales[]

The Tall Tale of Sqiffy and Bucko (non-canon)[]

Squiffy and Bucko worked for a bit of time at Master Chen's Noodle House. However, they were very mischievous and intentionally dropped Master Chen's dishes by running into each other, causing them to break. Right after this incident, they were fired.

The Hands of Time[]

Secrets Discovered[]

When Kai and Nya arrived at Chen's Noodle House and discuss about their parents, Skylor offers them noodles. However, the two do not eat the noodles and later leave their bowls to head to the Vermillion Swamps, leaving Skylor to enjoy her bowl of noodles.

Hunted[]

Firstbourne[]

During Lloyd's training with P.I.X.A.L. in her Samurai Mech, Nya was eating a box of noodles. However, when the Resistance left their base to avoid being found by the Sons of Garmadon, Nya left her noodles, which Mr. E picked up.

Two Lies, One Truth[]

Lloyd, Nya, Skylor, Dareth and Mystake are eating noodles whilst Mystake reveals her origins as an Oni to the Resistance.

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu[]

Questing for Quests[]

The ninja run into a salesman selling noodles at a Ramen noodle cart in Ninjago City.

Prime Empire Original Shorts[]

Upgrade[]

The Mechanic states that his new and improved truck has an automatic noodle machine, though he struggles to press the button to operate it. One of his goons helps him press the button, though the mechanic was displeased and threw the noodle cup at his face.

Prime Empire[]

Would You Like to Enter Prime Empire?[]

The ramen noodle cart was on the streets of Ninjago City.

Racer Seven[]

Noodles were depicted on some of the signs hanging above the noodle stand that Racer Seven ate at following the end of each race she participated in.

Ninjago Confidential[]

The ramen noodle cart was next to Laughy's.

Crystalized[]

The Council of the Crystal King[]

The Ninja rode inside of the Mechanic's Noodle Truck of Crime, with Kai at the wheel and Zane in the passenger seat while Cole and Jay guarded the Mechanic in the cargo hold. After Jay complained that he and Cole's assignment was boring, he began to rife around the various boxes stashed in the cargo hold, discovering that they were full of instant cup noodle soups, including chicken noodle, egg noodle, and minestrone. When the truck stopped, Jay picked out a cup of noodles and asked Zane to place it into the instant noodle maker while Cole began rummaging inside the boxes to pick out a snack as well, leaving all unaware that the Mechanic had detached his mechanical arm to release him from his binds. Meanwhile, Jay expressed his excitement to eat his cup of noodles, lamenting seconds after trying them that the noodles were cold, unaware that the noodle maker only makes cold noodles. His cup of noodles would ultimately be spilled and abandoned after the Mechanic took control over his truck and escaped, forcing the Ninja to pursue him into the sewers.

Safe Haven[]

Within the Newspaper warehouse, Wu helped serve bowls of noodles to other survivors of the Crystal Army's attack on Ninjago City.

Compatible[]

In an effort to keep up morale amongst the members of the The Resistance as well as the survivors, Skylor began to cook up bowls of noodles, which Kai helped to serve.

The Elemental Mechs[]

A Pain in the Mech![]

The Crossroads was hosting a noodle cook-off, where both Grab-Barg and the Lava-Tides were competing. Excited to witness the culinary showdown, Kai, Cole, Arin, Sora, and Riyu eagerly made their way to the event. However, Cole decided to bring along some noodles from Chen's Noodles House to enjoy during the cook-off, critizing the noodles from the Crossroads. Unfortunately, Sora found this act offensive, as it was considered inappropriate to bring noodles from outside the Crossroads during their own noodle cook-off, according to her perspective. After savoring the noodles he obtained from Grab-Barg, Kai joined the ninja in their fight against the Ice Dragons, who had been provoked by Lava-Tony's theft of their eggs.

After Lava-Tony's oven burst, noodles scattered across the Crossroads, resulting in a week-long cleanup. The ninja, covered in noodles, went back to the Monastery and informed Lloyd about the incident. Cole and Sora enjoyed the combination of noodles from the Crossroads and Chen's Noodle House, while Kai handed Lloyd some noodles tangled in his hair, as he was supposed to bring him lunch.

Season 2 (Dragons Rising)[]

The Blood Moon[]

While Arin and Sora stakeout All-Realm Antiques Emporium, Riyu hid in a dumpster, where he started to eat discarded noodles inside it. He was immediately spotted by an elderly woman dumping her trash.

They Gather for the Feast[]

Noodles was one of the foods present at the feast of the Tournament of the Sources.

The Surge[]

Cole eats pudding inside the teacher's lounge at Wu's Academy. Jay cries out that somebody ate his pudding, when Cole says that he did. Kai gives Jay his pudding cup, and Jay complains that it isn't cold, so Zane cools it for him.

The Hatching[]

As Wu tells the ninja they may ask him any question, Jay asks who ate his pudding cup, claiming that this was a question.

Scavengers[]

Zane's neural pathway was scrambled after rebooting the system, and he spoke pudding as part of his nonsense he was speaking.

Puffy Potstickers are dumplings served at Chen's Noodle House.

History

History[]

Years before Tournament of Elements[]

When Dareth was a child, his mother made him food with the same taste as the Puffy Potsticker, giving him a lifelong love of the food.[13]

Ninja Roll[]

Dareth walked into Chen's noodle house, demanding that they put the Puffy Potsticker back on the menu. They refused, and Dareth goes outside to follow the trucks. His pursuit accidentally led to him hopping into Nya's disguised DBX and accompanying her to Chen's Island.

Spellbound[]

After he was captured by Chen's cultists, Dareth decided to use parts of noodle machines to make his own Puffy Potsticker. His mentioning of using spare parts of the machines unwittingly gave Zane the idea to create a Roto Jet, which the Elemental Masters used in their escape.

The Corridor of Elders[]

When Skylor announced to Kai that she will take over her father's noodle business, Dareth overheard Skylor and begged her to put the potsticker back on the menu, and was ecstatic to learn that she will.

Kingdom Come[]

Misako gave some Puffy Potstickers to Ghoultar to convince him to convey info to the ninja about Morro's plan.

School for Crooks[]

After clearing up a misunderstanding between Kai, Skylor, and himself, Ronin mentioned his appreciation for the Noodle House's Puffy Potstickers.

Firstbourne[]

Dareth returned with one of Master Chen's stale Puffy Potstickers, which he made Lloyd eat.

Amber Spiral[]

While searching for clues about her mother, Skylor tried some potstickers in the village in the valley. According to Chamille, at least six food bloggers say they are the best potstickers in Ninjago, though Skylor disagreed.

Trivia

Trivia[]

  • They are called Sausages of Strength because immense strength is granted upon eating one, enough to wield the great Golden Long Sword, heavier than most weapons.[citation needed]
  • In The LEGO Ninjago Movie, the sausage piece is briefly used multiple times to represent Cole's headband.
  • The sausage piece is also included as a decorative element in sets, such as 71705 Destiny's Bounty.
  • The green hot dog in 71733 Epic Battle Set - Cole vs. Ghost Warrior and 71699 Thunder Raider is a reference to Cole's status as a ghost from Possession to "Day of the Departed".[15]

Snowberry Pies are a type of pie in the Merged Realms which are made with roasted snowberry filling.

History

History[]

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

The Merge: Part 1[]

Arin leaves a Snowberry Pie for the junkyard owners as compensation for the stolen parts. He later bakes another in his penthouse. He uses it to bribe Alfonzo Frohicky into letting them participate in the Mech Master 5000.

Crossroads Carnival[]

Arin bakes a Snowberry Pie at the monastery after training. He enters it at a pie contest at the Crossroads Carnival, only to lose to Grab-Barg again.

Writers of Destiny[]

Arin was feeding Riyu a Snowberry Pie as they waited at the Destiny's Bounty.

I Will Be the Danger[]

Some Snowberry Pies are seen on the desk while Kai was playing video games.

The Last Djinn[]

Some Snowberry Pies were on the ground while Mr. Frohicky was trying to vacuum the recreation room.

The Power Within[]

Arin bakes many Snowberry Pies for the ninja to celebrate closing the MergeQuake Storm.

The Elemental Mechs[]

The Mech Master[]

Snowberry Pies were present at Grab-Barg's stall after Arin was thrown into it by The Mechanic. After the Ninja defeated the Mechanic, they celebrated by stocking up on Garb-Barg's pies, including multiple snowberry ones.

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

They Gather for the Feast[]

Snowberry Pies were one of the foods present at the feast of the Tournament of the Sources.

Inside the Maze[]

Arin and Frak get Snowberry Pies from a Merlopian vendor in the City of Temples.

The Sword Shatters[]

Prior to Frak and Zur's match, the Ninja gathered together as Sora asked if any of them had seen Riyu. An elemental master walked past carrying a snowberry pie as they spoke, briefly catching Cole's attention. Cole would later get a slice of snowberry pie, presumably from the concessions stand, and was ready to eat it, but would be interrupted by Frak and Sora.

Following the match, Henjamin was seen sitting beside Wyldfyre and enjoying a snowberry pie.

During the intermission during Lloyd and Zeatrix's match, Henjamin and Ellie were seen walking past the ninja and carrying snowberry pies.

History

History[]

Legacy of the Green Ninja[]

Darkness Shall Rise[]

In the restaurant where Zane gets a job, the customers who watch him cook have a plate with several varieties of sushi on it.

Tournament of Elements[]

Only One Can Remain[]

While exploring his room, Cole discovers a compartment full of food, including sushi.

After Karlof is eliminated from Chen's Tournament of Elements, Kai can be seen with a plate with two pieces of sushi on it when the ninja meet up.

Prime Empire[]

Superstar Rockin' Jay[]

Two players with VR goggles are buying sushi from a local stand.

Another player is also eating sushi until the red visors start patrolling the streets.

Racer Seven[]

Racer Seven orders four pieces of sushi from a sushi stand, but the man running it states that she can only have two. She becomes upset and asks for four again, but he gives her a plate with only two pieces on it. After Lloyd arrives and begins to speak to her, the sushi server can be seen serving another plate of two sushi pieces to another customer.

The Temple of Madness[]

After entering a sushi bar inside the Temple of Madness, Jay and Nya were attacked by Monster sushi. Nevertheless, the pair were able to defeat the living sushi pieces by repeatedly slicing them into smaller pieces.

Seabound[]

Unsinkable[]

Jay ate sushi aboard the Hydro Bounty as the ninja embarked on an expedition to Tartarus Trench.

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

The LEGO Ninjago Movie[]

When questioned by Lloyd as to why he wanted to even conquer Ninjago City, Garmadon thought for a moment and believed it was because he enjoyed a really good sushi restaurant there a long time ago. This led to a brief fight on the subject, where Garmadon believed the restaurant's name was "Omakase," though Lloyd insisted that referred to the style of service.

Tuna Gelatin is a type of casserole made by Lobbo, which he claimed to be "world famous."

As its name suggests, it is a casserole whose ingredients implicitly include tuna and gelatin. One particular tray was also specified as having mints in as well. Like all of Lobbo's "world famous" casseroles, it peculiarly belches greenish fumes on occasion.

History

History[]

Dragons Rising, Season 3[]

The Spectral Lands[]

Multiple trays of casseroles were available as part of the "Endless casserole pit" in Lobbo's Totally Rad Arcade, Lobbo-Lobbo. Although Wyldfyre seemed interested in eating them, a horrified Nya discouraged her from doing so. Later however, Wyldfyre would noisily eat from one of the casserole dishes when Nya wasn't looking and Lobbo would also refill one of the dishes with another tuna gelatin casserole, briefly attempting to offer some to Nya who screamed in terror at the sight of the dish.
